analysis: Examined docs-only units. docs/architecture/inference.md head lines 1637-2261 are unchanged context; the only change in this file per the complete range map is head 1370-1382, which adds documentation that the Qwen inline MTP assistant speculates for one decode row and that ordinary decode appends target hidden rows to the assistant history, with rollback env switches DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY. This describes a performance and MTP-history behavior, not encryption, attestation, authorization, cache scoping (T-041 salt/HMAC/TTL unchanged) or billing. The described carry stays in-process (TB-007/T-028 posture unchanged). The documentation does not establish whether chained ordinary-decode history can mix rows across requests; the implementation (EngineV2LoopV2+MTPOrdinaryHistory.swift finalizeMTPOrdinaryHistory) is outside the supplied evidence. That is noted for integration as an unverified correctness/isolation contract, not a finding. docs/developer/test.md line 494 only adds RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark to a test filter, so it has no security impact. No threat-model regression was identified.
